finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: attacker can inject malicious commands in the input file
finding.assumptions: The `parse_line` function tokenizes the input buffer and uses `strdup` to copy the tokens. The tokens are then used to construct commands in the `hash_table_thread_function`.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.sink: insert(args->hash_table, HASH_TABLE_SIZE, args->lock, line.param_one, atoi(line.param_two), args->out_fp)
finding.trigger: attacker can inject malicious commands in the input file
finding.assumptions: The `hash_table_thread_function` uses the parameters from the parsed line to perform operations. If these parameters are not properly sanitized, they could be used to inject malicious commands.
